data.one_liner: Samples health data from Apple Health and Google Health Connect for CARP Mobile Sensing.
data.what_it_does: This package provides a sampling package that pulls health data from Apple HealthKit and Google Health Connect into the CARP Mobile Sensing framework. It wraps the health plugin and exposes a HealthService device for use in CAMS protocols.
use_when: You need to collect health metrics such as steps, weight, heart rate or sleep stages in a CARP study.
You are building a Flutter app that already uses carp_mobile_sensing and want to add native health data collection.
avoid_when: You are not using CARP Mobile Sensing or Flutter, or you only need a simple health data read without a full sampling framework.
You target platforms other than Android/iOS or do not need native health permissions.
strengths: Seamless integration with CARP Mobile Sensing framework.
Supports both Apple HealthKit and Google Health Connect.
Provides a ready-to-use HealthService device and permission handling.
weaknesses: Requires extensive native configuration and permissions on both platforms.
Setup is complex and error‑prone, especially for Health Connect API level 34.
No support for other health platforms or custom data types.
data.setup_notes: Must configure native health permissions (HealthKit for iOS, Health Connect for Android), add required permissions to AndroidManifest, enable HealthKit capability in Xcode, and follow the health plugin setup guide. No build_runner needed.
